title: heliotropium glabrum
intro: Heliotropium glabrum, commonly known as the rough heliotrope or smooth heliotrope, is a flowering plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Heliotropium glabrum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, and it may also have wound-healing and antiseptic properties.
